findings.highlight: I made her wait out here in the cold
findings.evidenceJa: 随分と待たせて寒い思いをさせてしまったなら
findings.governingReading: if he has kept her waiting long enough to make her cold
findings.explanation: A conditional premise is promoted into a settled factual account.

findings.highlight: Illya should not forgive Kiritsugu
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは切嗣を許さないだろう
findings.governingReading: Illya probably will not forgive Kiritsugu
findings.explanation: A prediction about Illya’s feelings becomes a moral claim that she ought not forgive him.

findings.highlight: she really must want to kill me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を殺すという言葉も本当だろう
findings.governingReading: her words that she will kill Shirou are probably sincere
findings.explanation: The likely truth of Illya’s threat becomes a claim about a desire framed with the ambiguous obligation-like “must.”

findings.highlight: I should invite her to my house despite that fact… no, more so because.
findings.evidenceJa: その理由があるからこそ、俺はこの子を、衛宮の家に招くべきだと思うのだ
findings.governingReading: precisely because those reasons exist, he believes he should invite her into the Emiya home
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the corrective sentence grammatically unfinished and drops the object of “because.”

findings.highlight: Illya gasps
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは呼吸を止めて
findings.governingReading: Illya stops breathing
findings.explanation: A stunned suspension of breath is reversed into an intake or expulsion of breath.

findings.highlight: She hugs me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の腕に抱きついてきた
findings.governingReading: she throws her arms around Shirou’s arm
findings.explanation: The childlike physical action of clinging specifically to his arm is generalized into a full-person hug.

findings.highlight: I have to persuade Saber no matter what.
findings.evidenceJa: あの声援に応える為にも
findings.governingReading: also in order to answer Illya’s cheering
findings.explanation: Shirou’s immediate motivation to live up to Illya’s encouragement disappears.

findings.highlight: it’s suicidal to invite Berserker’s Master into our house
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の陣地にあげるなんて自殺行為
findings.governingReading: inviting Berserker’s Master into one’s own territory is suicidal
findings.explanation: The tactical concept of admitting an enemy Master into one’s bounded territory is reduced to household location.

findings.highlight: don’t get angry about such a trifling matter
findings.evidenceJa: そこまで目くじらたてる事はない
findings.governingReading: there is no need to make such a great fuss over it
findings.explanation: Shirou objects to the scale of Saber’s alarm; the English instead commands her not to feel anger.

findings.highlight: it’s just that Saber was that mad
findings.evidenceJa: それぐらいセイバーが怒っていたと思ってほしいのだが駄目だろうか
findings.governingReading: he wants Saber to understand that he spoke so quietly because she was that angry, if she possibly could
findings.explanation: The explanatory plea linking his quiet delivery to her anger is reduced to a bare statement of her mood.

findings.highlight: Hello.
findings.evidenceJa: おじゃましまーす
findings.governingReading: “Excuse me for intruding,” playfully drawn out
findings.explanation: Illya’s culturally specific guest-entry formula becomes a generic greeting.

findings.highlight: The only potential problem is that it might be too bitter.
findings.evidenceJa: 苦い甘いのお茶としての問題だけだ
findings.governingReading: the only possible issue is whether, as tea, it is too bitter or too sweet
findings.explanation: Half of Shirou’s stated taste range disappears.

findings.highlight: it was very delicious
findings.evidenceJa: けっこうなお手前でした
findings.governingReading: “That was an excellent preparation,” a stock formal tea compliment
findings.explanation: Illya’s conspicuously learned tea-ceremony formula becomes a simple judgment of flavor.

findings.highlight: had low magical value
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術的な価値がない
findings.governingReading: has no value in Magecraft terms
findings.explanation: Complete absence of Magecraft value becomes merely low value.

findings.highlight: you people are savages that slash at each other bare-footed
findings.evidenceJa: 連中は裸足で斬りあう野蛮人だって
findings.governingReading: those people are barbarians who slash at one another barefoot
findings.explanation: The grandfather’s distanced contempt for dojo users is redirected at Shirou and Japanese people generally.

findings.highlight: You have servants to take care of that!
findings.evidenceJa: そーゆーところは使用人に任せておけばいい
findings.governingReading: places like that should simply be left to servants
findings.explanation: A class-conditioned assumption about who ought to handle storage becomes a factual claim that Shirou employs servants.

findings.highlight: The target she has a grudge against.
findings.evidenceJa: 少女が長年恨み続けた相手
findings.governingReading: the person the girl has continued to resent for many years
findings.explanation: The duration and persistence of Illya’s grievance disappear.

findings.highlight: She only wanted to kill him
findings.evidenceJa: 復讐という殺意でしかぶつかれなかった
findings.governingReading: she could confront him only through the murderous intent called revenge
findings.explanation: The tragedy that revenge was Illya’s only remaining mode of reaching Kiritsugu becomes a simple desire to kill.

findings.highlight: We’ll have to fight unless I leave this place before nightfall.
findings.evidenceJa: 夜になる前に別れないと戦いになっちゃう
findings.governingReading: if they do not part before night, the two will end up fighting
findings.explanation: The relational need to part is narrowed into Illya leaving the house, changing the condition attached to renewed combat.

findings.highlight: through the streets
findings.evidenceJa: 見慣れた町、見慣れた道を
findings.governingReading: through the familiar town and familiar roads
findings.explanation: The contrast between an intimately familiar setting and the feeling of walking it for the first time disappears.

findings.highlight: Makiri and Einzbern have deep tenacities.
findings.evidenceJa: マキリとアインツベルンの執念は深い
findings.governingReading: Makiri and Einzbern harbor deep obsessions
findings.explanation: The central characterization is rendered in conspicuously unnatural English and weakens centuries of fixation into generic persistence.

findings.highlight: how to quench her desire for revenge
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤ自身の復讐心を解放する術
findings.governingReading: a way to free Illya herself from her vengeful heart
findings.explanation: Liberating Illya from the structure of her revenge becomes suppressing or satisfying a desire.
